content:
maya: quick sync - Acme is asking for tenant embeddings cache + SSO. timeline squeeze. need MVP vs v1 decision by EOD Fri.

devin: we can ship a read-only cache with per-tenant namespaces + 24h TTL in ~2 sprints if we skip prewarm and write API.

arjun: infra flag - multi-tenant cache changes memory profile on dedicated pools. rushing writes risks OOM spikes and noisy neighbor issues. recommend deferring write path to v1.

sam: from metrics side, if writes are deferred we must add observability to measure cold-start rates and per-tenant hit/miss. acceptance criteria must include telemetry.

liz: proposed MVP acceptance checklist:
1) read-only embeddings cache: per-tenant namespace, 24h TTL
2) telemetry: hit/miss, p95 latency, per-tenant breakdown
3) fallback to origin model on miss with identical outputs verified by evals
4) runbook + rollback procedure

maya: agree. add customer signoff (Acme) and performance gating: p95 < 200ms for cached requests.

devin: rough impl notes:
- cache service in Rust behind router
- fast lookup path to KV, fallback synchronous generation
- optional background prewarm (disabled for MVP)
Disabling prewarm saves ~2 weeks.

arjun: operational ask: include eviction metrics and a circuit-breaker for high miss amplification. also propose temp per-tenant memory quotas during canary.

sam: can we run a 5-customer canary (incl Acme) and gate on hit rate >25% and no P95 regression before broad rollout?

liz: yes - use feature flag + staged rollout: canary -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. include immediate fallback toggle.

maya: tradeoff decision: ship read-only cache in MVP, move write API, prewarm, and compaction to v1. update launch criteria and timeline accordingly.

devin: timeline impact: moving writes out saves ~3 sprints of backend work and keeps target launch date intact. will include cost estimate.

arjun: note: cached vectors increase GPU memory usage; include cost delta and alarms.

sam: evaluation plan: run prompt set cached vs uncached to ensure no quality regressions and identical fallback behavior for determinism.

maya: action items:
- devin: open PR with implementation sketch + cost estimate by Tue
- arjun: add eviction/memory alarms and temp quotas by Wed
- sam: prepare eval prompt set and telemetry dashboard by Wed
- liz: update launch criteria doc and draft customer comms by Thu

deploy-bot: PR opened -> refs: github.com/redwood/cache/mvp-readonly (devin) :rocket:

devin: tagging @maya @liz - PR has toggleable flag and canary rollout plan + rough cadence graph.

maya: decision rule: if canary shows >25% hit and no perf regression we call MVP complete. otherwise disable flag and follow contingency comms.

liz: release notes items: update support runbook, FAQ explaining intermittent cache misses, and customer-facing opt-in instructions.

arjun: ops final - add temporary per-tenant quota and circuit-breaker thresholds for canary.

sam: consensus here. scheduling short sync Fri to sign acceptance criteria.

maya: thanks all - i'll consolidate into a decision doc after Fri's sync. :thumbsup:
